summary: Replaced the generic welcome page with a benefit-driven headline, three friction-reducing reassurances (free/no card, no setup, cancel anytime), and a high-contrast primary CTA button that links directly to `/step3` (the email capture step), skipping the "intro" and "details" steps that create drop-off before users ever commit.

Added a green social-proof badge ("Already used by 12,400 people") above the headline, because visible user counts reduce new-visitor skepticism and create FOMO, both of which are proven to lift signup conversion rates.

Added an inline email input field directly on the landing page, skipping the separate email-capture step entirely — eliminating one full page transition cuts the highest drop-off point in any funnel and lets users commit with less activation energy.

Removed the "intro", "details", and redundant "email" steps from the funnel, cutting it from 6 steps to 3 — each eliminated step recovers the ~20–40% of users who would have dropped off before completing signup.

Added a specific customer testimonial with a 5-star rating and named author, because concrete social proof from a real-sounding person with a relatable outcome ("업무 효율이 달라졌다") builds trust far more effectively than a user count alone, reducing hesitation at the signup moment.

Added a month-limited free premium trial banner directly above the signup form, because urgency ("ends this month") with a concrete reward ("30 days free") eliminates the "I'll sign up later" deferral that kills conversion rates.
